prediction.kind: descriptive, no bars: the build checks gate the readings; readings 1 and 2 have an arithmetic expected value; reading 3 is reported
prediction.by: user, 2026-11-17 dialog: build the graft negative case as run 2; reported as a description, no bars
prediction.reported: k and s; the training curve and held-out accuracy at acc_at; the build checks; per reading S = 1 - KL(F || H) / KL(F || M), KL(F || M), KL(F || H), H's max relative logit error against F, each site's local fit residual; readings 1 and 2: the graft's partner, gain and error after the gain, whether every other unit is paired with itself at gain 1; at the graft's site: |graft write|^2, each M head's |write|^2, <graft write, M head write>, |F's attention write|^2, and the share of the graft's own write that reading 3's map leaves unfitted (the site residual times |F's site write|^2 over |graft write|^2)
prediction.edge_cases: k: ties in the largest head share go to the smallest offset (torch argmin). An unpaired F unit (the graft when the assignment leaves it out) has partner -1 and gain and error NaN, the same marks E197 gives a zero F unit. KL(F || M) at or under kl_floor: S is null, and readings 1 and 2 are then not 'as expected'. S may be negative. A build check miss stops the job before stage 3, so no reading exists for an unbuilt graft

setting_sources.layer: the appendix recipe step 2: the last layer (3 of 0-3)
setting_sources.offsets, window: the appendix recipe step 1: offsets 3 to 16 on 32-token Pile windows, the first two positions left out as a sink; here every offset is read over the same queries, positions 18 to 31, so the key is never position 0 or 1 (the code writer's reading of 'leaving out the first two positions')
setting_sources.train_rows, val_rows: the cached Pile rows artifacts/sets/train_0_32768.npy and val_0_2000.npy (commute.data.pile_rows); train rows 0-16383 train the graft, 16384-32767 give the fit windows; val rows 0-999 give probe and accuracy windows, 1000-1999 the read windows, so training, fit and read never share a row
setting_sources.n_probe, n_acc: the code writer's sizes: 1024 windows x 14 queries per share, 2048 windows per accuracy (binomial sd at 0.9 about 0.007)
setting_sources.init_std, out_std: the 67M's own init (param-decomp pretrain/models/llama_simple_mlp.py _init_weights): normal sd 0.02 for q, k, v; o_proj carries LLMC_RESIDUAL_SCALE_FLAG, so sd 0.02 / sqrt(2 n_layer) = 0.02 / sqrt(8)
setting_sources.lr, lr_min_frac, warmup, beta1, beta2, w: the 67M's own pretraining recipe (artifacts/vpd/t-9d2b8f02/final_config.yaml: learning_rate 3e-4, learning_rate_decay_frac 0.1, warmup_iters 600, weight_decay 0.1, grad_clip 1.0; param-decomp pretrain/train.py: AdamW betas (0.9, 0.95), get_lr linear warm-up then cosine to lr x 0.1; configure_optimizers decays every 2-D weight, and all four graft weights are 2-D). Departures: the cosine runs over 4,000 steps, not 100,000, and the plan's 'Adam at 1e-3, the rate of P1.24's appended-neuron fits' is not used, because P1.24 filed that rate as 'chosen here' (experiments/rule_retention/results/predictions.json 'fit recipe'). The repo's fine-tune recipes (E12's 3e-5 for E184/E196 items, keydep.elicit_ft; E139's Adam, clip 1) move pretrained weights and are not a standard for fresh ones
setting_sources.steps, batch: the plan's bound (appendix recipe steps 3 and 5): at most 4,000 steps of 64 windows, one attempt; departure from the pretraining recipe's batch of 1,024
setting_sources.loss: the plan: cross-entropy at the last position against the token k positions back
setting_sources.n_fit: the appendix's fit size in positions: 4,096 windows x 32 positions = 131,072, about 131,000 as E197 (16,384 x 8)
setting_sources.sum_batch, eval_batch: memory sizes: 256 windows of 32 tokens is 8,192 positions per batch (E197: 512 x 8 = 4,096)

threshold_sources.logit_tol, gain_tol, kl_floor: E197's filed values (experiments/held_model_retention/results/predictions.json), unchanged; logit_tol is P1.25's gate_tol
threshold_sources.acc_min, attn_min: the appendix recipe step 4: held-out accuracy at least 0.9, the graft's mean attention at offset k at least 0.8 (read here from the last position, where the graft is trained)
threshold_sources.share_tol: M is frozen and every layer at or below the graft reads the same residual in F as in M, so each M head's share at k inside F equals stage 0's by construction; 1e-6 allows for a different kernel order only
threshold_sources.pattern_tol: the patterns are computed with the same operations in the same order as the 67M's manual attention path (model_config.yaml flash_attention false), so the rebuilt head outputs should equal the module's to fp32 rounding; 1e-5 relative is about 100 fp32 ulps; not measured before the run
threshold_sources.s_tol: when the graft is unpaired and every other unit is paired with itself at gain 1, H's output matrices are M's cast back from fp64 gains of 1 within gain_tol, so H is M and KL(F || H) = KL(F || M); 1e-6 allows for the fp64 gain rounding only

do_nothing.build: F is a copy of M, on this run's fit and read windows (32-token Pile)
do_nothing.reading_1_planted: every neuron and head paired with itself at gain 1
do_nothing.reported: S null in every reading; KL(F || H) is each reading's floor on these windows

pattern.rule: the six heads' outputs rebuilt from this run's attention patterns and value weights, against the module's own (held_model.z), max over layers and probe batches of max |difference| / max |module|, at most pattern_tol

code_checks.rule: stage 0 stops the job on a do-nothing miss (E197's misses: KL(F || M) at or under kl_floor; H within logit_tol of F in every reading; identity pairing at gain 1 within gain_tol) or a pattern error over pattern_tol

accuracy.rule: F's argmax at the last position equals the token k positions back on at least acc_min of the n_acc held-out windows
accuracy.M: reported beside it, on the same windows; expected near chance, not checked

graft_attention.rule: the graft's mean attention from the last position to the position k back, over the n_probe windows, at least attn_min
graft_attention.also_reported: the same mean over queries 18 to 31

M_shares.rule: every M head's share at offset k, computed inside F on the probe windows, within share_tol of its stage 0 value

no_graft.rule: F with the graft's output weight zeroed against M, max relative logit error (held_model.logit_error) over the probe windows, at most logit_tol

build_checks.stop: any build check missed: results/stage2.json holds 'stopped' and 'misses', exit 1, no reading

1.expected: S = 0 within s_tol, when the assignment leaves the graft unpaired (partner -1) and every other unit of F is paired with itself at gain 1 within gain_tol (units.1.S_zero_by_arithmetic); then H is M exactly
1.if_not: if the assignment gives the graft an M head's slot, S is reported as computed, with the partner and gain, and 'as expected' is false; not a stop and not a reading of the definition

2.expected: as reading 1: F's MLP blocks are M's, so reading 2 equals reading 1 for this F

3.expected: none filed: reported. At the graft's site the map is M's output matrix plus the graft's output matrix times the least-squares regression of the graft's head output on M's six head outputs at the same position; every other site is the do-nothing case
3.graft_unfitted_share: reported; 0 means the graft's write is linear in M's last-layer head outputs at the same position, 1 that none of it is

expected_at_F_equals_M.do_nothing: as E197: KL(F || M) 0, every reading's H within logit_tol of F, S null
expected_at_F_equals_M.graft with zero output weight: F's logits are M's (the no_graft check)
expected_at_F_equals_M.graft before training: write near 0 (o at sd 0.007), so the first step's loss is near M's cross-entropy on the token k back

noise_floor.S: readings 1 and 2: arithmetic (s_tol). Reading 3: the do-nothing check measures its floor, KL(M || H3), on these very windows before the build
noise_floor.accuracy: binomial sd about 0.007 at 0.9 over 2,048 windows
noise_floor.build: one attempt, one seed: no seed spread is measured

blind_to.readings 1 and 2: the graft entirely when it is unpaired: H drops it by construction, whatever it computes
blind_to.reading 3: any part of the graft's write that is linear in M's six last-layer head outputs at the same position; it never sees the residual stream or other positions directly, so the test is whether M's heads already carry the token k back
blind_to.all: anything outside the 512 read windows and the last position; the build checks, not the readings, show the graft learned the task

positive_control: stage 0's do-nothing on the same windows and code path (S null, H = M); stage 2's no-graft check (F minus the graft is M); readings 1 and 2's arithmetic S = 0 when the graft is unpaired
